# How status works
The app loads proc data and generate reports and charts. No root account required, only need a regular user. The app will not write and modify files on the server.

The app is tested on Ubuntu, CentOS, Alpine, Gentoo stage3, openSUSE and Debian. It should support all major linux distributions.
